name: Stuffing and Chicken
description: A comforting chicken breast casserole with Stove Top stuffing, Swiss cheese, and cream of chicken soup.
recipeIngredient: 4 boned and skinned chicken breast halves

recipeInstructions.text: Place chicken breasts in a sprayed 8×8 inch casserole dish.
Put a slice of Swiss cheese on top of each breast.
Spread 1⅓ cups of dry Stove Top stuffing over the cheese.
Spread the cream of chicken soup over the stuffing layer.
Bake at 350 °F for 1 hour.

keywords: chicken casserole, stuffing, Swiss cheese, comfort food

_similar.name: Parmesan Chicken
_similar.description: A crispy Parmesan-crusted chicken dish baked with spaghetti sauce and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix Parmesan cheese with bread crumbs and set aside.
Mix eggs, salt, and pepper.
Dip boneless chicken breasts in egg mixture, then coat with bread crumb mixture.
Arrange coated chicken breasts in a baking dish.
Cover with tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.
Pour spaghetti sauce over the chicken and continue baking.
Before serving, sprinkle grated mozzarella cheese on top and bake for an additional 10 minutes until browned.

_similar.keywords: Parmesan chicken, breaded chicken, Italian-American cuisine

_similar.name: Chicken with a Chinese Accent
_similar.description: A sweet and savory chicken dish with a Chinese-inspired flavor profile, featuring soya sauce and brown sugar.

recipeInstructions.text: Fry chicken breasts in a frying pan with oil and soya sauce until the outsides are done.
Transfer the chicken to a casserole dish.
Mix the remaining ingredients with soya sauce and pour over the chicken.
Bake for 35 minutes at 350°F.
Serve the chicken with rice.

_similar.keywords: Chinese chicken, sweet and savory, baked chicken

_similar.name: Classy Chicken
_similar.description: A creamy, curry-flavored chicken dish with asparagus or broccoli and a cheddar cheese topping.
recipeIngredient: 1 (10 oz) pkg frozen asparagus or broccoli

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the chicken into 2×4 inch pieces and sprinkle with pepper.
Saute the chicken slowly in oil over medium heat until white and clear, about 6 minutes. Drain.
Cook asparagus or broccoli until tender crisp, drain, and arrange in the bottom of a buttered 7-inch diameter casserole dish.
Place the cooked chicken on top of the asparagus or broccoli layer.
Mix the cream of chicken soup, mayonnaise, curry powder, and lemon juice together and pour over the chicken.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese over the top.
Bake, uncovered, at 375 °F for 30 to 35 minutes.

_similar.keywords: creamy chicken, curry chicken, asparagus, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Turkey A La King
_similar.description: A creamy turkey dish made with mushrooms, celery, and green pepper, served over toast or rice.

recipeInstructions.text: In a skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add mushrooms, onion, celery, and green pepper. Cook until vegetables are tender.
Remove vegetables from skillet with a slotted spoon and set aside.
In the same skillet, blend flour into the butter to make a roux. Gradually add chicken broth and milk, stirring constantly.
Bring mixture to a boil and cook for 2 minutes, or until it thickens.
Add reserved turkey and vegetables to the sauce. Heat through.
Serve over hot toast, biscuits, or rice.

_similar.keywords: turkey a la king, creamy turkey, mushrooms, celery, green pepper

_similar.name: Chicken and Broccoli
_similar.description: A creamy chicken and broccoli pasta bake with Parmesan cheese and mushroom soup.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the small shells pasta according to package directions. Drain.
Add cooked broccoli, chopped chicken, cream of mushroom soup, milk, Parmesan cheese, and ground pepper to the cooked pasta.
Boil the mixture for 2 minutes to heat through and combine the sauce.
Serve hot with a cranberry salad.

_similar.keywords: chicken and broccoli, pasta bake, creamy chicken
